anchorAudit.rationale: The source and 1600×900 output were inspected at native pixels. Every retained term points to a visible conveyor, scanner-scale, operator control, payment, bagging, cabinet or ergonomic component. Brands, printed copy, prices, payment state and operating claims are excluded.
